
##### Homogeneous network interference {#sec-homogeneous-interference}

We introduce the assumption of *homogeneous network interference* which reduces the complexity of network exposure mappings. This assumption holds that the effect of a neighbor’s treatment on unit $i$ is the same regardless of which neighbor it is, and regardless of the position of unit $i$ in the network. What matters is the *number* or *proportion* of treated neighbors, not their identity. Finally, it restricts the network exposure values so that they are contained by a finite set.
